   765  @[no_expose] instance (h : IsImmersion I J n f) : NormedAddCommGroup h.complement :=
   766    Classical.choose <| Classical.choose_spec h
   767  
   768  @[no_expose] instance (h : IsImmersion I J n f) : NormedSpace 𝕜 h.complement :=
   769    Classical.choose <| Classical.choose_spec <| Classical.choose_spec h
   770  
   771  lemma isImmersionOfComplement_complement (h : IsImmersion I J n f) :
   772      IsImmersionOfComplement h.complement I J n f :=
   773    Classical.choose_spec <| Classical.choose_spec <| Classical.choose_spec h
   774  
   775  /-- If `f` is an immersion, it is an immersion at each point.
   776  
   777  Note that the converse statement is false in general:
   778  if `f` is an immersion at each `x`, but with the choice of complement possibly depending on `x`,
   779  there need not be a global choice of complement for which `f` is an immersion at each point.
   780  The complement of `f` at `x` is isomorphic to the cokernel of `mfderiv I J f x`, but the `mfderiv`
   781  of `f` at (even nearby) points `x` and `x'` are not directly related. They have the same rank
   782  (the dimension of `E`, as will follow from injectivity), but if `E''` is infinite-dimensional this
   783  is not conclusive. If `E''` is infinite-dimensional, this dimension can indeed change between
   784  different connected components of `M`.
   785  -/
   786  lemma isImmersionAt (h : IsImmersion I J n f) (x : M) : IsImmersionAt I J n f x := by
   787    rw [IsImmersionAt]
   788    use h.complement, by infer_instance, by infer_instance
   789    exact h.isImmersionOfComplement_complement x
   790  
   791  /-- If `f = g` and `f` is an immersion, so is `g`. -/
   792  theorem congr (h : IsImmersion I J n f) (heq : f = g) : IsImmersion I J n g :=
   793    heq ▸ h
   794  
   795  /-- If `f: M → N` and `g: M' × N'` are immersions at `x` and `x'`, respectively,
   796  then `f × g: M × N → M' × N'` is an immersion at `(x, x')`. -/
   797  theorem prodMap {f : M → N} {g : M' → N'}
   798      [IsManifold I n M] [IsManifold I' n M'] [IsManifold J n N] [IsManifold J' n N']
   799      (hf : IsImmersion I J n f) (hg : IsImmersion I' J' n g) :
   800      IsImmersion (I.prod I') (J.prod J') n (Prod.map f g) :=
   801    (hf.isImmersionOfComplement_complement.prodMap hg.isImmersionOfComplement_complement).isImmersion
   802  
   803  open IsManifold in
   804  /-- The identity map is an immersion. -/
   805  protected lemma id [IsManifold I n M] : IsImmersion I I n (@id M) := by
   806    use PUnit, by infer_instance, by infer_instance
   807    exact IsImmersionOfComplement.id
   808  
   809  /- The inclusion of an open subset `s` of a smooth manifold `M` is an immersion. -/
   810  lemma of_opens [IsManifold I n M] (s : TopologicalSpace.Opens M) :
   811      IsImmersion I I n (Subtype.val : s → M) := by
   812    use PUnit, by infer_instance, by infer_instance
   813    exact IsImmersionOfComplement.of_opens s
   814  
   815  @[deprecated (since := "2025-12-16")] alias ofOpen := of_opens
   816  
   817  /-- Every `ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E H` is an immersion when viewed as a map `H → E`. -/
   818  protected lemma _root_.ModelWithCorners.isImmersion {n : ℕ} :
   819      IsImmersion I (modelWithCornersSelf 𝕜 E) n I := by
   820    use PUnit, by infer_instance, by infer_instance
   821    exact I.isImmersionOfComplement
   822  
   823  /-- A `C^n` immersion is `C^n`. -/
   824  theorem contMDiff
   825      (h : IsImmersion I J n f)
